verdict.rationale: Open WebUI's own web interface is the full-featured surface, with voice and video calls and agent supervision beyond basic chat. The docs state it is a PWA that can be added to a phone home screen, desktop taskbar, or dock, so the same app reaches desktop and mobile. However, there are no dedicated native desktop or mobile apps, and parity on mobile is implied rather than documented. Missing for 10: native desktop/mobile apps, an explicit cross-surface feature-parity statement, hands-on evidence of the mobile PWA experience.

support.subject: As an everyday user, the assistant also meets me in official web, desktop, or mobile apps with feature parity beyond the chat basics

citations.quote: Open WebUI is a Progressive Web App (PWA). Add it to your phone's home screen, your desktop taskbar, or your dock.
Speech-to-text, text-to-speech, hands-free voice & video calls
